      Lovable and Supabase developer to complete an internal web app

      We are a UK construction consultancy with an internal web app for estimating and quoting. The core is already built and heavily tested, with over 1,800 automated tests. We need an experienced senior developer to finish the remaining features, tighten security and fix known bugs, so we can take a real job from a CSV take-off through to an issued quote. This isn't a new build or a small bug-fix job. A cheap or junior bid is likely to break the calculation logic. Please only apply if you've shipped production React, TypeScript and Supabase apps with row-level security and are comfortable in a large, already-tested codebase. Tech stack - React, TypeScript and Tailwind, built in Lovable - Supabase: Postgres, authentication, row-level security and edge functions - Vitest, with over 1,800 tests that must stay green - GitHub with two-way Lovable sync (it will be connected before you start); all work is reviewed before it's accepted Current state The estimating core exists: take-off import, cost building, a large catalogue, templates, a pricing matrix, supplier records, programme and preliminaries screens, a client portal, notes, and PDF and Excel export. Sign-up is already invite-only, and database access has been tightened. A full run of one real job and the remaining feature work are still outstanding. Scope (fixed-price milestones) A written brief with acceptance checks will go to the shortlisted freelancer once an NDA and IP assignment are signed. In outline: 1. Paid familiarisation, about one week: read the code, run the tests, and quote the milestones below. 2. Forgiving data import: accept typical CSV and Excel take-off files, match rows safely, and ask for confirmation rather than silently picking the wrong item. 3. One-click auto-build of preliminaries, including site costs generated from the programme. 4. Programme-driven recalculation: preliminaries and other time-based costs update when the programme changes. 5. Supplier enquiry and quote workflow: raise enquiries, record quotes, and keep unconfirmed prices out of the issued total. 6. Senior review and sign-off: a hold-point before a quote can be sent to the client. 7. Client portal: client project requests and a project tracker. 8. Linked drawings: uploaded drawings linked to the relevant quote items. 9. Security hardening: auth settings, storage and policy tidy-up, and validation so invalid quantities or costs can't quietly change a total. 10. Mobile layout: the navigation currently covers the screen at phone width. 11. Email delivery: invitations and status emails must reliably arrive. Milestones 2 to 6 are the priority for a first usable version. The rest follow in the order we agree after the familiarisation week. You won't be asked to invent commercial rates or judge whether a price is right; that stays with us. How we work - An NDA and IP assignment are signed before the full brief or any code is shared, and everything you produce belongs to us. - All work is done in a test environment with sample data. You won't have access to live commercial data, and you don't publish or deploy. - Database changes are supplied as migration scripts for our review, never run against the live system. - All existing tests must pass at every milestone, and agreed benchmark totals must stay unchanged. - Fixed price per milestone, paid through PeoplePerHour. - You'll need to overlap with UK working hours. UK-based is preferred. To apply, please tell us: 1. Two Supabase projects you've worked on and what you built, especially anything with row-level security or a mature schema. 2. Whether you've worked on a Lovable-generated codebase before. 3. How you handle database changes on a system that's already in use. 4. Your availability, your overlap with UK hours, and whether you're UK-based. 5. How you'd break a job this size into milestones, and a ballpark price for the familiarisation week. Applications that don't answer these questions won't be considered.
